cause_quote: The new CSS used `[data-mobile-composer="true"][data-composer-editing="false"]` to apply `white-space: nowrap` to the textarea and `display: none` to `.agent-chat__composer-controls`, even when a draft was present.
user_saw: When a mobile user typed a draft and tapped outside the composer, it shrank to one line and hid the toolbar.
summary: The fix keeps the mobile composer expanded with its toolbar visible while an unfocused draft contains text.
reasoning: I checked the introducing commit's parent and verified that the existing mobile layout rendered the toolbar without a focus requirement. PR #176498 tied both the one-line layout and toolbar visibility to editing state alone. A later layout change briefly allowed the text to wrap again while still hiding the unfocused toolbar, and the immediate predecessor restored the one-line layout.
